title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Early-Completion Bonus
content:
The early-completion bonus of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry rewards a registrant who completes the registry soon after the occasion. It is added, in percentage points, to the completion percent of an order line on which the registrant redeems the completion discount (her or his own purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status), and it follows the calendar days from the registry's event date to the line's purchase date:

- at most 30 calendar days (the first early window), a line bought before the event date included, adds the first early-completion percent of **4** percentage points;
- more than 30 but at most 60 calendar days (the second early window) adds the second early-completion percent of **2** percentage points;
- otherwise — more than 60 calendar days — no early-completion bonus is added.

A line purchased on the event date counts 0 days, and a line purchased before the event date counts fewer than 0 days; both are at most 30 days and fall in the first window.

## Boundary table (hypothetical event date 1 March of a year that is not a leap year)

| Purchase date | Calendar days after the event date | Bonus |
|---|---|---|
| 20 February | fewer than 0 | 4 |
| 31 March | 30 | 4 |
| 1 April | 31 | 2 |
| 30 April | 60 | 2 |
| 1 May | 61 | none |

## Points of judgement

- The count runs from the event date the registry shows to the purchase date of the order line, not to the day the redemption is recorded.
- The windows are inclusive at 30 and at 60 days.
